title: Semivariance and Semivolatility in Portfolio Selection: A Unified Framework for Downside-Risk Portfolio Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.32638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we study downside risk in portfolio selection beyond minimum-risk models, where semivariance and its square root, semivolatility, yield the same portfolio. Downside-risk models are often presented as direct extensions of their variance-based counterparts, although different classes of portfolio problems require different properties of the risk measure. We classify these models by the degree of positive homogeneity of the risk measure in the weights: degree one makes risk contributions add up to the portfolio risk and keeps diversification and reward-to-risk ratios scale invariant. For three thresholds, the portfolio mean, zero and a market-index return, we state a non-degeneracy condition on long-only downside risk under which the risk-parity, most-diversified and Sortino-ratio problems are well posed. translated_title: 投资组合选择中的半方差与半波动率：下行风险组合模型的统一框架
translated_abstract: 本文研究投资组合选择中超越最小风险模型的下行风险问题，其中半方差及其平方根——半波动率——会产生相同的投资组合。下行风险模型通常被呈现为其基于方差的对应模型的直接推广，然而不同类别的组合问题对风险度量有着不同的性质要求。我们按照风险度量关于权重的正齐次性程度对这些模型进行分类：一次齐次性使得各资产的风险贡献之和等于组合总风险，并使分散化比率与收益-风险比率保持尺度不变性。针对三个阈值——组合均值、零以及市场指数收益——我们给出了仅做多情形下下行风险的非退化条件，在该条件下，风险平价、最大分散化以及Sortino比率问题均为适定问题。在该条件下，这两个比率问题可归结为凸规划问题，且半波动率的可微性保证了（……）
tldr: 本文提出了一个按风险度量正齐次性程度对下行风险组合模型进行分类的统一框架，并给出了一个非退化条件，在该条件下风险平价、最大分散化与Sortino比率问题均适定且可归结为凸规划。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework that classifies downside-risk portfolio models by the degree of positive homogeneity of the risk measure, and establishes a non-degeneracy condition under which the risk-parity, most-diversified and Sortino-ratio problems are well posed and reduce to convex programs.
